meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 把 Gmail 接进 Claude:之后它能搜索、阅读、发送和起草邮件,还能管理标签和过滤器。真实密钥由 OneCLI 保管,运行时才注入,环境里不存真实凭证。
howto.when: 这技能要人工装一次;装好后,你在对话里让 Claude 搜邮件、发信、整理标签等,就会调用 Gmail 工具。第一次调用要等一两秒。

say.text: 搜索我的收件箱,找上个月的发票。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Gmail 搜索工具查收件箱。

say.text: 列出我的 Gmail 标签。
say.note: Claude 会调用标签工具,返回你的标签列表。

say.text: 帮我给李雷发一封邮件,约下周三下午开会。
say.note: Claude 会调用发送邮件工具。

howto.what_en: Adds Gmail to Claude via an MCP server: search, read, draft and send emails, manage labels and filters. OneCLI holds the real OAuth tokens; the container only sees stubs and tokens get injected at request time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks Claude for Gmail actions — search, read, send, draft, or label. First call may take a couple of seconds while the MCP server starts and OneCLI exchanges tokens.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month.
say_en.note: Claude calls the Gmail search tool.
Claude calls the label list tool and returns your labels.

say_en.text: Send an email to Li Lei about meeting next Wednesday afternoon.
